verdict.rationale: Kick documents role-based access control that lets you decide who can see and do what in the workspace. The docs also describe the accountant working inside the books: adjusting the Chart of Accounts, reviewing and closing periods, and locking them, with every change attributed by name in the Activity audit trail. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the invite flow for external users, named accountant/bookkeeper roles and their permission scopes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
